description: A soft, organic bedroom vignette with warm Mediterranean or California-casual influences. The wall is finished in a textured pale grey-beige plaster with an organic matte surface, and a large round mirror with a simple thin frame hangs on it, its circular form echoed by a round-backed upholstered accent chair in warm cognac-caramel velvet positioned against the right wall. The floor is light honey-toned oak hardwood, partially covered by a natural jute or sisal area rug in sandy neutral tones. A low wide nightstand in natural light oak with a flat top and minimal drawer fronts sits at the edge of the bed, its surface holding a small ceramic vase with a single eucalyptus sprig and a few small stones or objects, along with a stack of two thin books. The bed is partially visible on the left, dressed in layered linen bedding in misty grey-blue and warm cream with a textured ribbed blanket at the foot. A warm gentle glow rises from the nightstand surface, emanating from a pleated fabric form resting on a rounded ceramic base, its warm amber light diffusing softly upward and washing the plaster wall. Sheer linen curtains filter golden afternoon sunlight from an unseen window at right, casting dappled shadow patterns on the wall and chair. The palette is warm and organic: plaster grey, honey oak, cognac amber, dusty blue linen, and natural greens.
